## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`; `!` for breaking)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit; contract where the protocol or the Hetzner request shape matters)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, tool descriptions, `.env.example`) if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets or real project data in code, tests or logs
